title: Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting ensures airfield personnel safety
description: Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting Marines respond and provide emergency aid to Marines during a simulated hard landing at Marine Corps Air Station New River March 8. Crash fire rescue conducts the simulated drill multiple times a week to guarantees their readiness and response to emergencies.
